seo.title: AI appointment booking agent | Steps AI
seo.description: Book appointments from WhatsApp, Instagram and your website into Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, Calendly, Cal.com or Square Appointments.

walkthrough.title: From a question to a confirmed booking.

steps.label: Answer the question
steps.customer: How long is a first consultation?
steps.agent: A first consultation is 45 minutes. Would you like to book one?
steps.note: The agent answers from your information first.

steps.label: Offer times
steps.agent: Thursday has 11:00 or 3:30 free. Which suits you?
steps.note: Times come from your connected calendar.

steps.label: Confirm the booking
steps.agent: You are booked for Thursday at 3:30, Priya. See you then.
steps.note: The appointment is added to your calendar.

quote.excerpt: We get a lot of questions from people who are interested but not ready to talk to sales yet. StepsAI handles that part really well. By the time someone books with us, they’ve usually already checked pricing, integrations, and whether we can support their use case.
